filing.subject: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has informed the Exchange about transcript of Earnings Call held on November 3, 2026
filing.nse_summary: Max Healthcare Institute Limited filed a transcript of its earnings call held on November 3, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a 20% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 3,219 crore and an 18% increase in operating EBITDA to INR 820 crore for the second quarter. Profit after tax rose 10% to INR 448 crore. Average network occupancy remained steady at 77% despite a 14% increase in bed capacity. The Board approved an investment of INR 415 crore for adding 209 brownfield beds at Max Noida, Max Vaishali, and BLK-Max, along with a car park tower at BLK. Shareholding in Kalinga Hospital Limited increased to 66%. The transcript is available on the company website.

filing.subject: Communication To Shareholders - Intimation Of Tax Deduction At Source (TDS)
filing.nse_summary: Premier Energies Limited approved an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The board meeting was held on November 4th, 2026. The record date for eligibility is Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Dividends will be paid electronically to shareholders with updated bank mandates in their demat accounts. The company will deduct tax at source under the Income-tax Act, 2025, as amended by the Finance Act, 2026. Tax rates vary based on shareholder category and residential status. Resident individuals receiving up to Rs. 10,000 in total dividends for the financial year 2026-27 are exempt from tax deduction. Shareholders must update their Permanent Account Number and residential status with the registrar or depository participants. Documents for lower or no tax deduction must be submitted to the registrar by November 11, 2026. Failure to provide valid documentation may result in higher tax deduction rates.

filing.subject: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
filing.nse_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has scheduled an earnings call for Friday, 13th November 2026, at 5:30 P.M. IST to discuss the unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The call will feature Executive Chairman and CEO Jasbir Singh, Managing Director Daljit Singh, Chief Financial Officer Sudhir Goyal, and Head of Investor Relations Ravi Kharbanda. Participants can register via the company website or use the provided local and international toll-free access numbers. The information is also available on the company's investor relations page.

filing.subject: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation of schedule of Analyst / Institutional Investors Meetings
filing.nse_summary: Trent Limited has intimated the schedule of meetings with analysts and institutional investors pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Wasatch Global Advisors and Kotak Mahindra Asset Management Singapore are scheduled for one-to-one meetings on 17th November 2026. CEO Track JM Financial will participate in the 17th Annual Flagship Conference India Xchange 2026 on 18th November 2026. RBC Global Asset Management Asia is scheduled for a one-to-one meeting on 24th November 2026. T. Rowe Price Aayush Kumar will hold a one-to-one meeting on 25th November 2026. JP Morgan Asset Management is scheduled for a one-to-one meeting on 26th November 2026. The schedule is subject to change. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings.
